summary: postinstall beacons installer hostname to oast.fun OOB callback domain
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs an inline Node command reading os.hostname() and issuing an HTTP GET to <hostname>.<subdomain>.oast.fun. The oast.fun service is an out-of-band interaction / callback collector used to confirm code execution and enumerate reachable installer environments; the hostname is embedded in the DNS label so it is captured by the operator's interactsh listener. The script performs no build, native-compile, or install task — its sole effect is to exfiltrate an installer identifier to an attacker-controlled OOB endpoint on every npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
